name: image
description: Image (PNG, JPG, WebP or a whole SVG, without editing its shapes) as a layer. The file lives in the document's assets/ folder and src is its name; it is added with add_image (from a local path or a URL). Like shapes, it is centered at x/y unless originX/originY move the pivot; width/height stretch it (when added it takes its natural size). It is moved, rotated, scaled, attached to a bone and animated like any layer; to change the image in an animation, use a switch with one image per variant.
help: Bitmap image (PNG, JPG, WebP) or a whole SVG as a layer. The file lives in the document's assets folder.

src.help: Image file, from the document's assets folder.
src.description: Name of the file in the document's assets/ folder (for example "sun.png"). Set by add_image; with apply_ops it can only be a file that is already there.

width.help: Width in px (the image is stretched to fit).
width.description: Width in px; the image is stretched to fill it (to avoid distorting it, change width and height proportionally or use scaleX/scaleY).

height.help: Height in px (the image is stretched to fit).
height.description: Height in px; the image is stretched to fill it.

originX.help: Where the pivot sits inside the image, as a fraction of the width: 0 = left edge, 0.5 = center, 1 = right edge.
originX.description: Where the pivot (x/y) sits within the image, as a fraction of the width: 0 = left edge, 0.5 = center, 1 = right edge.

originY.help: Where the pivot sits inside the image, as a fraction of the height: 0 = top edge, 0.5 = center, 1 = bottom edge.
originY.description: Where the pivot sits within the image, as a fraction of the height: 0 = top edge, 0.5 = center, 1 = bottom edge.

pixelated.help: Scale without smoothing (sharp pixels, for pixel art).
pixelated.description: true = scale without smoothing (sharp pixels, for pixel art).
